t: A teaching radio that can listen and transmit from 325 MHz to 3.8 GHz.
steps: Buy the ADALM-Pluto from a distributor such as DigiKey, Mouser or Richardson RFPD.
Plug it into your computer with the included USB cable.
Open the USB drive that appears and read info.html.
Install libiio and GNU Radio from the official Pluto wiki steps.
Set the device address to pluto.local and confirm the link.
Connect transmit to receive with the loopback cable and send a test tone.
Screw on an antenna and view the 2.4 GHz band in receive mode.
Keep any on-air transmitting to bands your license allows.
